sourcesAttempted.note: Three items surfaced: (1) AML/CTF small-business Privacy Act expansion effective 2026-07-01; (2) Children's Online Privacy Code exposure draft published 2026-03-31, consultation closes 2026-06-05, registration target 2026-12-10; (3) ADM transparency obligation effective 2026-12-10. All three classified LOW.

PIPA amendment passed 2026-02-12, promulgated 2026-03-10, effective 2026-09-11. Raises fine ceiling to 10% of total revenue; CEO accountability; enhanced consent for combinable cookie identifiers. Classified LOW (no immediate technical banner change, but high-fine jurisdiction from Sept 2026).

CSL amendment effective 2026-01-01 confirmed. Personal Information Outbound Certification Measures (Decree No. 20) and GB/T 46068-2025 standard effective 2026-03-01 confirmed. Both already effective. Classified LOW. SECONDARY label applied to primary URL.

ANPD became independent February 2026; published 2026-2027 enforcement priorities targeting advertising/profiling. Five thematic investigations underway. No new cookie rule enacted; existing October 2022 guidance remains operative. Classified LOW (risk elevation notice).

Proposal entered ordinary legislative procedure 2026-11-19. Proposed Art. 88a (consent default, 6-month refusal cooling-off, single-click refusal, exemption list) and Art. 88b (machine-readable signals). Not adopted. Classified LOW. Labelled SECONDARY pending primary confirmation of final proposal text URL.
No new amendment or enforcement action touching cookies/consent in window. PDPA 2021 amendments fully in force; advisory guidelines revised May 2024 remain current. No qualifying item.
Draft amendment bill in consultation (late 2025); no enacted text. PDPC enforcement action (iris scanning, Nov 2025) is pre-window. No new qualifying item in lookback window.

Bill C-27 confirmed dead (Parliament prorogued Jan 2025; Minister Solomon confirmed June 2025 it will not return). PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25 remain operative. No new federal legislative event in window.

Draft APPI amendment estimated to be published 2025/tabled 2026, effective est. 2027. No enacted text in window. Telecommunications Business Act External Data Transmission Rule (June 2023) remains operative. No qualifying item.
PDPL Executive Regulations (2024) stable; no new amendment in window. No qualifying item.
Privacy Act 2020 in force; no new amendment or guidance touching cookies/consent in window. No qualifying item.

Guidelines 01/2025 on Pseudonymisation still pending final publication (stakeholder event report 2026-02-18; listed in Work Programme 2026-2027). No final guidelines yet. No qualifying item this cycle.

SAT guidance (published 2026-04-29) confirmed as HIGH severity. NOT included in this LOW digest per severity routing rules. Flagged to orchestrator for separate HIGH alert. Primary source confirmed: https://ico.org.uk/about-the-ico/media-centre/news-and-blogs/2026/04/final-storage-and-access-technologies-guidance-published/
